observations.behavior: Adds an optional boolean parameter to the _get_where_clause method, allowing the caller to opt-out of including timestamp range filters in the generated HogQL query. The timestamp bounds are no longer added unconditionally; they are only added if the flag is True.
observations.posthog_connection: This could allow the trace query runner to generate queries that do not filter by the configured date range, potentially broadening the search scope or excluding the date filter entirely depending on the caller's intent. This changes the query construction behavior rather than fixing a bug or adding a new feature, but it does introduce a configuration-dependent behavior. No caller is shown in this hunk, so the actual use and benefit are not demonstrated.
